SVNIT Surat Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SVNIT Surat Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat (SVNIT Surat), a prominent government institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for SVNIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive by SVNIT Surat is Teaching Assistant, offering a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Teaching Assistant posts at SVNIT Surat.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for SVNIT Surat Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Teaching Assistant position is a Walk-in Interview, requiring direct attendance at the venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Teaching Assistant post is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should report on time.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have M.Tech/M.E. and B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering or allied branch with First class or equivalent CGPA, or a Ph.D. in Civil Engineering or allied branch.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Teaching Assistant at SVNIT Surat?
faq.answer: The salary for the Teaching Assistant post ranges from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this SVNIT Surat recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process for Teaching Assistant includes Document Verification, a Written Test, and a final Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for SVNIT Surat Teaching Assistant?
faq.answer: The job location for the Teaching Assistant position is Surat, Gujarat, at the Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology.
